items.evidence: `private class ErpMock implements HttpCalloutMock` and `Test.setMock(HttpCalloutMock.class, mock);`

items.item: Covers a success response and an error response (for example 500) with asserts
items.evidence: The 201 and 200 tests use `Assert.areEqual('ERP-42', erpId, ...)`. The 500 test uses `new ErpMock(500, ...)` with `Assert.isTrue(e.getMessage().contains('500'), ...)` and `Assert.isTrue(thrown, ...)`.
